explain.ja: 雁木といえば、図1-1のツノ銀雁木が最もよく指されています。2017年ごろからプロの将棋で流行し始めた形で、右銀を4七に置くのが特徴です。金銀が斜めにジグザグに並ぶ構えです。
explain.en: Speaking of Gangi, the Tsuno-gin Gangi (horn-silver Gangi) in Diagram 1-1 is played the most. It began to gain popularity in professional games around 2017 and is characterized by placing the right silver on 4七. Golds and silvers line up diagonally in a zigzag.

section.ja: スタンダードなツノ銀雁木

explain.ja: 図1-2の囲いは右玉雁木と呼ばれます。囲いの堅さはありませんが、陣形のバランスが良く、相手の攻めをうまく受け流すように戦います。金銀の並びはツノ銀雁木と同じですが、玉の位置が違います。
explain.en: The castle in Diagram 1-2 is called Right-King Gangi. It lacks solidity but the formation is well balanced, and the fight is played by deflecting the opponent's attack. The arrangement of golds and silvers is the same as Tsuno-gin Gangi, but the king's position differs.

section.ja: 堅さよりもバランス!右玉雁木
section.en: Balance over solidity! Ranging Rook Right Gangi

explain.ja: 図1-3は2枚銀雁木と呼ばれる形で、ツノ銀雁木のような近年の形と区別して「旧型雁木」と呼ぶこともあります。右銀を5七に置く構えで、単に雁木囲いというとこの形を指すこともあります。雁木の長所は、陣形のバランスが良く上からも横からの攻めにも対応しやすいこと、角道を止めるので角に強いこと、横歩取り・角換わり・振り飛車など様々な出だしから合流できること、攻め筋が豊富なことです。短所は、矢倉ほど堅くないこと、角道を止めるため手損になりやすいこと、相手に矢倉に組まれると崩しにくいことです。
explain.en: Diagram 1-3 shows Two-Silver Gangi, sometimes called the old-style Gangi to distinguish it from recent forms such as Tsuno-gin Gangi. The right silver goes to 5七, and "Gangi castle" alone sometimes means this form. Its strengths: a well-balanced formation that handles attacks from above and from the side, strength against the bishop because the bishop line is blocked, the ability to be reached from various openings such as Yokofudori, Bishop Exchange and Ranging Rook, and a rich variety of attacks. Its weaknesses: less solid than Yagura, a tendency to lose a tempo because of blocking the bishop line, and difficulty breaking a solid Yagura if the opponent builds one.

section.ja: 昔からある伝統的な形、2枚銀雁木
section.en: The traditional shape from long ago: Double Silver Gangi

title.ja: 図2-1 横歩取りの出だし
title.en: Figure 2-1: Opening of Side Pawn Capture

explain.ja: まず横歩取りの出だしから雁木戦法を目指します。お互いに角道を開け、飛車先を伸ばしたところからがポイントです。
explain.en: First, aim for Gangi from a Yokofudori opening. The key point comes after both sides have opened the bishop diagonal and pushed the rook pawn.

section.ja: 横歩取りの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Side Pawn Taking opening

title.ja: 図2-2 角道を止めて駒組みを
title.en: Figure 2-2: Stop the bishop diagonal and build

explain.ja: 図2-1から角道を止めて駒組みすれば雁木の形にできます。相手の飛車先は、▲7七角と上がって受けます。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-1, blocking the bishop diagonal and developing makes a Gangi shape. Guard against the opponent's rook pawn by raising the bishop to ▲7七角.

section.ja: 横歩取りの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Side Pawn Taking opening

explain.ja: 図2-2からは、お互いに攻める手がなく、じっくり囲い合う展開になります。ここで雁木囲いを組みます。この形は横歩取りを拒否できるので、横歩取りが苦手な人にも向いています。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-2, neither side has an attack and both build their castles patiently. Build the Gangi castle here. This form can decline Yokofudori, so it suits players who are weak at it.

section.ja: 横歩取りの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Side Pawn Taking opening

line.text: △3二金、▲6八銀、△6二銀、▲6七銀、△4二銀、▲7八金、△5二金、▲4八銀、△4一玉、▲5八金

title.ja: 図3-1 角換わりの出だし

explain.ja: 次は角換わりの出だしから雁木に組む流れを見ます。図3-1から▲3三角成と角交換するのが角換わりですが、他の指し方はないでしょうか。
explain.en: Next is the flow from a Bishop Exchange opening to Gangi. From Diagram 3-1, ▲3三角成 exchanging bishops is Bishop Exchange, but is there another way to play?

section.ja: 角換わりの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Bishop Exchange opening

title.ja: 図3-2 やはり角道を閉じる
title.en: Figure 3-2: Close the bishop diagonal again

explain.ja: やはり角道を閉じるのが雁木の指し方です。ここからはじっくり雁木囲いを目指します。
explain.en: Closing the bishop diagonal is again the way to play Gangi. From here, aim for the Gangi castle patiently.

section.ja: 角換わりの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Bishop Exchange opening

title.ja: 図3-3 雁木囲いの完成

explain.ja: 角換わりの形から、角道を止めて雁木囲いを組みます。このように角換わりを拒否して雁木を目指す形は、プロでもよく指されます。
explain.en: From the Bishop Exchange shape, block the bishop diagonal and build a Gangi castle. Declining Bishop Exchange to aim for Gangi like this is often played even by professionals.

section.ja: 角換わりの出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from the Bishop Exchange opening

line.text: △8四歩、▲6八銀、△8五歩、▲7七角、△6二銀、▲4八銀、△5四歩、▲5八金、△4一玉、▲6七銀

title.ja: 図4-1 振り飛車模様の出だし
title.en: Figure 4-1: Opening with Ranging Rook tendencies

explain.ja: 今度は振り飛車模様の出だしから雁木に組む流れを見ます。先手は居飛車にするか振り飛車にするか態度を決めず、駒組みを進めます。
explain.en: Now the flow from a Ranging Rook-style opening to Gangi. Black develops without deciding between Static Rook and Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 振り飛車の出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from a Ranging Rook opening

title.ja: 図4-2 振り飛車と見せかけた雁木
title.en: Figure 4-2: Gangi disguised as Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図4-1のような振り飛車模様から雁木に組むことができます。先手は、相手の駒組みを見てから居飛車にするか振り飛車にするかを決められます。
explain.en: From a Ranging Rook-style position like Diagram 4-1 you can build Gangi. Black can decide between Static Rook and Ranging Rook after seeing the opponent's development.

section.ja: 振り飛車の出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from a Ranging Rook opening

line.text: △3二玉、▲7八金、△3三角、▲4八銀、△5二玉、▲5八金

title.ja: 図4-3 四間飛車に組む

explain.ja: 図4-1からは、もちろん通常の振り飛車に組むこともできます。▲6八飛と振れば四間飛車の駒組みです。この駒組みは、居飛車と振り飛車の両方を指す人におすすめです。
explain.en: From Diagram 4-1 you can of course also build an ordinary Ranging Rook. Swinging the rook with ▲6八飛 gives a Fourth File Rook setup. This development is recommended for players who play both Static Rook and Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 振り飛車の出だしから雁木を目指す
section.en: Aim for Gangi from a Ranging Rook opening
